items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: He's the loudest trumpet player that I was in New Orleans, in the world... The loudest trumpet player we ever had.

ctx.x: Mm. What about Buddy Bowling? Tell me about him.

He's the loudest trumpet player that I was in New Orleans, in the world. The loudest, he was even louder than Louie. The loudest trumpet player we ever had. Buddy Bowling. He could be playing across the river there, you know. You could hear him playing, after certain hours at night, and he's way there in Algiers on this side of town. He's the loudest. He's one of the most famous men I've ever was here.
